artworks.prompt: Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a single face-on spiral galaxy, bright warm core and blue-white spiral arms with dark dust lanes, a few tiny stars around.

Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a rocky planet seen as a thin crescent, its sunlit rim lit warm orange from the lower left (by the black hole's accretion disk off-frame), the rest dark. ONLY the lit crescent shows; the dark side is the background colour.

Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a single red giant star, a large softly glowing orange-red sphere with a subtle mottled surface and gentle corona, filling about half the frame.

Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a small comet with a bright compact head and a long faint blue-white ion tail and a softer dust tail, crossing diagonally.

Like a real deep-space astrophotograph, natural colours, no glow halo around the frame: a pale banded gas giant with thin tilted rings, half lit from the lower left by warm orange light, the night side dark.
